text:
infra-bot: ALERT: region fallback loop detected across us-east <-> us-west <-> eu (smart-routing v3). Auto-escalating to #incidents.

pagerduty: PAGER: sre_oncall_1 on call for infra-high. Incident triggered by health-check flapping in routing policy.

sre_oncall_1: I'm on it, seeing ~30% error spike and repeated reroutes between regions. headers: X-Routing-Decision shows variant=v1 -> v2 -> v1 repeatedly.

carla_infra: logs look like healthprobe 200->502->200 on the same node set. probe interval 5s, consecutive-failures 1 (we set this low for fast failover).

alice_runtime: that consecutive-failures=1 was rolled out in canary last week to speed up failover for degraded GPUs. Could be too aggressive when combined with inter-region latency.

carla_infra: confirmed. Probe jitter + 1-fail flips is making smart-router think region unhealthy, triggers fallback to next region, which then sees increased load and briefly fails probe, bouncing back. loop.

alice_runtime: also seeing model-variant mismatch in the routing table. Some requests are getting routed to model-quantized-v2 (lower mem) but fallback routes point to model-standard-v1. When kvcache warmup fails, latency spikes and probe fails.

dave_prod: any customer impact yet? which tenants hit most?

sre_oncall_1: AcmeCorp and BetaHealth show increased 503s for ~10m. We have metric spikes in p50/p95. No full outage but error budget burn risk.

ops-bot: Reaction: :rotating_light: (8) — Notify #support if SLA risk rises.

carla_infra: immediate mitigation plan: 1) bump consecutive-failures to 3 in probe config for the three affected regions 2) pin routing policy to prefer same-model variants across fallbacks (disable cross-variant fallbacks) 3) scale up capacity in eu by 2 nodes.

alice_runtime: I can push a hotfix to the smart-routing config to disable cross-variant fallback (toggle: routing.disable_cross_variant_fallback = true). Recommend doing that first.

sre_oncall_1: do it. Execute steps with one command per region. I'll watch.

carla_infra: running:
```
# disable cross-variant fallback
redwoodctl routing set --policy-name smart-v3 --set routing.disable_cross_variant_fallback=true --regions us-east,us-west,eu
```

carla_infra: applied to us-east/us-west/eu, propagation within 10s.

alice_runtime: pushed variant-pin rule, verifying traces. kvcache warming looks better now (fewer cold misses).

sre_oncall_1: logs show immediate reduction in variant switching. error rate trending down from 30% to 9% in last 90s.

carla_infra: next change: bump probe consecutive-failures to 3. Command:
```
redwoodctl infra probe update --name region-health --set consecutive_failures=3 --regions us-east,us-west,eu
```

carla_infra: probes updated. expected dampening effect.

ops-bot: Automated note: rolling config change detected by deploy-bot for infra/probes (change-id: cfg-2026-119).

pagerduty: NOTE: Paging suppressed for now. If error rate > 15% again, escalate to SRE Pager.

alice_runtime: scaling eu by 2 nodes as planned: `redwoodctl capacity scale --region eu --add 2 --pool inference-dedicated`

carla_infra: capacity change started — ETA 45s for new nodes to register.

sre_oncall_1: monitoring customer impact. BetaHealth 503s dropped to baseline in last 2m. AcmeCorp still ~2% elevated — tracking.

dave_prod: notify Sales/Account for AcmeCorp please, include mitigation note and ETA for full return to normal.

ops-bot: @sales-team FYI: late-stage mitigation applied for AcmeCorp, 2 nodes added to eu, routing policy pin applied, probe dampening in effect. Expected resolution <10m.

carla_infra: capacity shows healthy and join successful. New nodes registered, backend occupancy decreasing.

alice_runtime: final check: kvcache hit rate improved, avg token latency back to normal for median requests.

sre_oncall_1: error rate now 0.6% across regions, p95 latency within SLO. Marking incident as mitigated. Preparing short postmortem notes.

dave_prod: root cause summary draft: aggressive probe sensitivity (consecutive-failures=1) + cross-variant fallback allowed routing to incompatible model variant which caused kvcache cold starts and transient latency/failures. The combination caused a cascading fallback loop across regions.

carla_infra: next actions (short-term): revert canary probe config, add canary test for cross-variant compatibility; (long-term): add hysteresis in smart-router, require model-compatibility matrix before fallback, and add circuit-breaker for rapid inter-region bounce.

ops-bot: Incident mitigated by SRE & Runtime. Incident severity: sev3 -> downgraded.

pagerduty: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated at 1719999999 + 66s. On-call handoff to carla_infra for monitoring during business hours.

sre_oncall_1: handing off to @carla_infra for 2h watch. Leaving notes: commands run, config IDs, affected tenants AcmeCorp/BetaHealth, dashboards updated.

carla_infra: taking over watch. I'll open a follow-up ticket in triage board and assign to runtime and infra teams for the fixes.

alice_runtime: will prepare the compatibility matrix and a small test harness to validate variant fallbacks in pre-prod.

dave_prod: thanks team. I'll draft customer comms for AcmeCorp and loop in account exec.

sre_oncall_1: closing thread here; ping if anything reoccurs. :thumbsup:
